contentList.content: Tear the magic out of the target's hands. The target loses <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HASTE">Hastened</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLESS">Bless</LSTag>. Neither an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRolls">Attack Roll</LSTag> nor a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> stops this little thief!
Carrying off what was taken. Movement speed increased by [1], and Attack Rolls gain a +[2] bonus.
This planar creature cannot remain long on the Material Plane, and vanishes when this condition ends.
The Pyre called this creature before the party was strong enough to face it, and the crossing has weakened it.
